title: Concept: Permissions-Policy grants a powerful feature to every origin
description: The response delegates a powerful feature to every origin. Permissions-Policy restricts which frames may use capabilities like the camera and microphone; a wildcard removes the restriction for any origin the page embeds. The header is increasingly common but is often copied with wildcards that were meant as placeholders.
applicability: HTML responses that deliver a Permissions-Policy header.
risk: Feature delegation to untrusted frames; LOW severity.
